episodes.title: Refined Aggression
episodes.summary: When the Duke of Halstead dies, his second son inherits everything, including the title, house and grounds — plus a whole heap of trouble.

episodes.title: Tackle Tommy Woo Woo
episodes.summary: The toffs and their gamekeeper hunt a new kind of prey. Susie enlists some help to clean up the mess, and Halstead Manor is blessed with a holy visitor.

episodes.title: Where's My Weed At?
episodes.summary: Jimmy gets distracted on the job. As supply chain issues delay deliveries, the Horniman brothers take a risky ride to placate a dissatisfied customer.

episodes.title: An Unsympathetic Gentleman
episodes.summary: Susie is keen to expand the business. Eddie is determined that it won't be on his estate, so the Hornimans search for alternative locations.

episodes.title: I've Hundreds of Cousins
episodes.summary: Distribution issues in Europe and a theft on the farm cause a headache for Eddie and Susie — until they make a new acquaintance who can help them out.

episodes.title: All Eventualities
episodes.summary: Eddie's doubts about Susie continue to grow. But there's 15 million pounds of dirty money to be laundered before she'll consider leaving the estate.

episodes.title: Not Without Danger
episodes.summary: Bent on vengeance, Susie goes against her father's orders. Eddie offers to help her but is less certain than ever about where his allegiances lie.

episodes.title: The Gospel According to Bobby Glass
episodes.summary: A familiar face returns to settle a score with Freddy. Bobby decides it's time to retire and wants Eddie and Susie to make the necessary arrangements.

episodes.title: The Road to Kingdom
episodes.summary: An Italian gangster, a royal sheikh and a cash-hungry lord join Eddie for a shooting party. With his eyes on a peerage, he needs it to go off with a bang.

episodes.title: There's a Rat in the Kitchen
episodes.summary: Eddie makes a deal with the Mafia in Milan, while Jack preps for a high-stakes night on the town. But will either be able to deliver on their promise?

episodes.title: Do You Reject Satan?
episodes.summary: The cost of restoring the Halstead estate to its former glory continues to spiral — while the farm staff's demand for more pay comes at an impossible price.

episodes.title: The Bigger Picture
episodes.summary: The House of Lords is split down the middle, so Eddie looks to the church for help. But to get the bishops on side, he needs to ruffle a few feathers.

episodes.title: A Suburban A-Road on the Outskirts of Basingstoke
episodes.summary: Eddie faces the violent consequences of his betrayal — and the cost of his loan. Susie and Joe head to Peru to expand the business behind Bobby's back.

episodes.title: The Bells of San Domenico
episodes.summary: Marco and Eddie mix business with pleasure amid preparations for the big day. As one guest causes trouble, will the event end in a wedding — or a funeral?

episodes.title: This Mad Circus
episodes.summary: When Halstead Manor gets overrun with vermin, it's up to Geoff to stamp them out and save his employers. Susie accuses Bobby of tinkering with the plane.

episodes.title: Bring Me the Head
episodes.summary: A furious Eddie plots his revenge — until Susie steps in. As the truth behind the break-in comes to light, the Horniman family is shaken to its core.
